source.description: Manual turning-movement count by more than 50 resident volunteers for the neighborhood working group, Tuesday February 25, 2025.
source.method: Volunteers tallied turning movements at each intersection for one hour. A car is counted once on each block it travels. Pedestrians, bicycles and signal queues were also logged.
caveats: One day, one hour each period.
Five Telegraph Avenue entries were not counted in the AM, so AM and PM totals compare only on the 13 entries counted in both (732 AM, 983 PM).
Full-route shares are lower bounds: cars that turned off partway are not included.

Per-block volumes, access points, route diagrams and example intersections were transcribed from the map images in the archive PDF (see the notes file for how they were read and where they are uncertain).

routeDiagramsKey.semantics: Inferred (the archive prints no legend). Numbers by an arrow between intersections: vehicles leaving the previous intersection onto that block. Green numbers at an intersection: straight-through and vehicles turning onto the route. Red: vehicles turning off the route. Margin numbers: plain = vehicles that join the route mid-block (net of the node sums); in parentheses = vehicles whose trip ends on that block.
routeDiagramsKey.checks: Node sums reproduce the printed table totals for all routes except where listed in each reconciliation field.
routeDiagramsKey.sides: west and east refer to the compass side of the route street; routes run north-south.
